dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT / Micro Focus ACUCOBOL dialect; generated by TOTEM RAD tool. Uses HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, USAGE IS SIGNED-SHORT, USAGE IS COMP-X, USAGE IS COMP-4, CRT STATUS, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, 88-level WHEN SET TO FALSE, 78-level constants — all characteristic of ACUCOBOL-GT.

purpose.domain_detail: Order management / sales order variation for Italian retail/distribution (Geslux ERP system — 'Variazione Ordini Clienti' = Customer Order Modification)
purpose.summary: This is a large, generated ACUCOBOL program named 'gordcvar' that handles customer sales order modification (variazione ordini clienti) within the Geslux ERP system. It manages a wide range of related files (orders, clients, agents, warehouses, promotions, price lists, etc.) and provides an interactive GUI screen for editing and validating order records. The program was generated by the TOTEM RAD framework.

notable_features: Generated by TOTEM RAD framework with structured comment markers {TOTEM}
ACUCOBOL-GT GUI extensions: HANDLE OF WINDOW, HANDLE OF FONT, STATUS-BAR
149 COPY statements for modular file definitions (.sl and .fd copybooks)
USAGE IS SIGNED-SHORT and COMP-X (ACUCOBOL numeric types)
88-level conditions with WHEN SET TO FALSE clause
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 668KB / 20495 lines. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS. The program_type is effectively an interactive online program using ACUCOBOL GUI (not CICS), so 'online-cics' is used as the closest enum value for an interactive screen program. Italian locale evident throughout.
